name: MrOS lateral spine radiographs (Osteoporotic Fractures in Men)
what: lateral thoracic and lumbar films of 5,994 men at six US centres, two visits (2000-2002 and about 4.6 years later), with Genant semi-quantitative vertebral fracture grades per vertebra; one deep-learning study used 4,461 subjects and 15,524 films; the image counts and the request steps to confirm on the page
level_truth: Genant grades on named levels, so level truth exists
licence: an NIA Outgoing Human Data Transfer Agreement signed by the PI and Wayne State's Signing Official: non-profit research on the approved project only, no redistribution, no re-identification, acknowledgement, 12 months renewable, destruction certified at the end
how_to_get: Sign in at https://agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov/ (NIH RAS through Login.gov or ID.me, institutional email) and enter the institution on the profile page.

Requests, Request for Materials: tick Data and Images and the studies MrOS and SOF in one request, and paste the fields of the drafted request (the project's shared folder, dataset-requests/nia-biobank-mros-sof-request.md); upload the protocol, the IRB letter, the Collaborator Attestation signed by the PI and the Signing Official, and a CV.

After the scientific review (several weeks) and the signed agreement, the images are download links on the request's Data tab; the package is free, and is fetched as a Slurm job only on the owner's word once its exact size is known.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; a research data request through the MrOS coordinating centre (an online application with a proposal), not sent; the images are not on dbGaP, whose phs000373 covers genotypes (to confirm on the page); older osteoporotic spines with compression fractures, the anatomy the C-arm sees in kyphoplasty

the Biobank's request process read from its pages (symphony-template docs/research/nia-aging-research-biobank-requests.md); one Request for Materials for MrOS and SOF drafted for the owner, not submitted

obstacles: the owner's hand: who files as Requester/PI (the Biobank takes only a permanent tenure-track professor or senior researcher; a trainee goes under Authorized Users)
the owner's and Wayne State tech transfer's answer to the form's required commercial-purpose question, since the agreement bars commercial use
an IRB determination covering data under an NIA transfer agreement (HPR 2026-269 covers only data without an agreement), a supplement as HPR 2026-330 was
the Biobank's form lists the study for data only, not images, on 2026-10-24; the package size is not published and is asked in the request's Comments before any download
